content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 2.1)**

§ 2.1 binds us to a three-year, USD 2,000,000-per-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right — the playbook's walk-away scenario, and short of even the fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty). It also contradicts § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no minimum-volume commitment) and the Order Form fee structure in § 7.1.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: § 2.1 replaced with "Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term. Customer has no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or shortfall obligation," with the 12-month reducible/true-up fallback offered in the comment.
